findings.title: --stats API-mode enumerator silently drops 52 of 253 window merges whose /commits/<sha>/pulls answers []
findings.claim: policy_lint.mjs --stats --since v6.6.0 at 1936d5ca reports 201 merged pull requests while main's first-parent history holds 253 `Merge pull request #N` merges, and prints no line naming the 52 it dropped.
findings.mechanism: fetchPullsBySha maps a sha only when /commits/<sha>/pulls returns rows; enumerateMerges (API mode) then skips every unmapped first-parent commit as a stamp. PRs #1098-#1165 return [] (their PR records 404), so their merges vanish from the population and from STATS COVERAGE's denominator without an unfetched/UNCHECKED marker.

findings.proposed_fix_scope: In API mode treat a first-parent commit whose subject is `Merge pull request #N` and whose /pulls rows are empty as merge #N with unfetchable data: count it, list it on the unfetched line; fetchWindow must record rather than abort on its 404.

findings.title: 22 re-verification rounds after a moved head caught 0 defects; 12 heads moved only by merges or ci: commits
findings.claim: Over v6.6.0..1936d5ca every one of the 22 parsable verdicts re-verifying a head that moved after a `merge` verdict was again `merge` (0 blocked), and 12 of those heads differed from the reviewed one only by merge commits or `ci:` bot commits.
findings.mechanism: An approving verdict binds an exact head, so any move -- including merging main to clear DIRTY or a bot re-record -- costs a full fix-review round; nothing distinguishes a move that changes the branch's diff from one that does not.

evidence.unit: reverify rounds blocked (of 22; 11 merges-only, 1 ci-bot-only, 10 branch content)

findings.metric_definition: Among verdicts following a `merge` verdict on a different head (statsHistogram reverify), the count whose verdict is `blocked`; plus git first-parent classification of prev..head.
findings.phenomenon_property: A review round is spent only where it can catch something: a head move that leaves the branch's diff against its merge base unchanged does not cost a fix-review round.

null_control.value: repair rounds after a blocked verdict: 21 (where all catches happen); prod_repeat_entries 6
null_control.note: the rework that does catch is the repair arm, not the reverify arm

findings.proposed_fix_scope: A mechanical diff-equivalence check (branch diff vs new merge base byte-identical to the reviewed diff, bot ci: commits excluded) that carries the verdict across a merges-only move; full fix review only when it fails. Policy change: owner approval needed.

findings.title: Body-answer blocks (8) exceed every engineering block class (max 1); record-and-body 12 vs engineering 7
findings.claim: Of the window's 21 blocked verdicts, 8 block because the PR body did not answer a red check (root-cause-unanswered 6, untaught red-check 2) while no engineering class has more than 1, and the record-and-body bucket (12) exceeds engineering (7).
findings.mechanism: The root-cause trigger (a check went red on a branch commit and the body does not name it) is a mechanical predicate over the check-runs listing and the body, yet it is enforced only by the fix reviewer, so each miss costs a full review round.
